@T.prim_func
def scrc_k0(p0_handle: T.handle, p1_handle: T.handle, p2_handle: T.handle, p3_handle: T.handle):
    x1, x2 = T.int32(), T.int32()
    p0 = T.match_buffer(p0_handle, (x1, x2), strides=(x2, 1))
    x0 = T.int32()
    p1 = T.match_buffer(p1_handle, (x0,), "int32", strides=(1,))
    p2 = T.match_buffer(p2_handle, (x0,), "int32", strides=(1,))
    p3 = T.match_buffer(p3_handle, (x0,), strides=(1,))
    # with T.block("root"):
    bx = T.launch_thread("blockIdx.x", x0)
    tx = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.x", 128)
    ty = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.y", 1)
    tz = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.z", 1)
    with T.block("tilelang_root"):
        T.reads(p1[bx], p2[bx], p0[p1[bx], p2[bx]])
        T.writes(p3[bx])
        index0: T.int32 = p1[bx]
        index1: T.int32 = p2[bx]
        value: T.float32 = p0[index0, index1]
        p3[bx] = value

    p2 = T.match_buffer(p2_handle, (256,), "int32", strides=(1,))

    # with T.block("root"):

    tx = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.x", 128)
    ty = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.y", 1)

    with T.block("tilelang_root"):
        T.reads(p1[bx], p2[bx], p0[p1[bx], p2[bx]])
        T.writes(p3[bx])
        v3: T.int32 = p1[bx]
        v4: T.int32 = p2[bx]
